div.div: Run 24 times the W-octave, incrementing i to
cover all the values of Tr and Tm.
Run it as 12 pairs of two W-octaves and extract
a sub-key set from each pair.
After running W(2i) and W(2i+1), the current state of KAPPA encodes one full set of sub-keys for quad-round i.
